rows.details: Engineered Wrinkles: Toward Harnessing the Wrinkling Instabilities in Soft Active Materials
Department of Science and Technology, New Delhi, India
Initially up to 31 March 2027, extendable up to 6 more months or till the end/termination of the project, whichever is earlier, based on performance
IIT Indore, Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites highly motivated, sincere, hardworking and research-oriented candidates for the post of a postdoctoral Research Associate. Educational qualification: PhD in Mechanical Engineering (with strong mathematical background) with publications in reputed journals. Knowledge required: nonlinear elasticity, continuum mechanics, stability analysis, and computational solid mechanics. The notice does not mention a separate desirable qualification, experience requirement or age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate is paid Monthly Rs. 58,000/- + HRA (as applicable). The engagement is initially up to 31 March 2027. It is extendable up to 6 more months or till the end/termination of the project, whichever is earlier, based on performance.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The project work listed in the notice is: Formulating nonlinear governing equations to analyse the mechanical behaviour and stability of electroactive soft materials. Investigating the influence of electric fields, mechanical pre-stretch, and material properties on wrinkle formation and evolution. Developing numerical methods and finite element models to predict wrinkle patterns, critical instability conditions, and post-buckling responses. Exploring the controlled generation and manipulation of wrinkles for designing functional soft actuators and adaptive structures.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Research Associate
content_sections.text: Applications are made by email. Interested candidates send a detailed CV along with publications and all self-attested marks sheets/certificates to [email protected] by 29 November 2026. The notice names no application form and gives no subject line for the email. Documents named in the notice: Detailed CV along with publications All self-attested marks sheets/certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an in-person or online interview. Selected candidates will be intimated by email. The notice gives no interview date.
